laws.rule: Akagera park operator describes daytime self-drive from 06:00-18:00 and directs self-drive access through the southern entrance, labelled Mutumba Gate on its page. Confirm the gate name/current entry instructions before setting out. Wet-season 4x4 is RECOMMENDED, not asserted mandatory. Guided night drives are separately offered to overnight guests; daytime self-drive hours do not authorise independent night driving.
